name: ai.datavidence/datavidence-financials
title: Datavidence Financials
description: Normalized US-GAAP financial statements & fundamentals from SEC EDGAR, as MCP tools for LLM agents.

environmentVariables.name: FL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the Datavidence Financials API. Use sandbox_demo_key for a no-signup trial (sample data); set your real key for live SEC data.

environmentVariables.name: FL_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to the production origin; point at a marketplace gateway (RapidAPI/AWS) for metered BYOK access.

environmentVariables.name: FL_API_KEY_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: HTTP header to send the key in (e.g. X-RapidAPI-Key for the RapidAPI gateway).
